# Third-party notices

Original OpenNetwork design-system code and design tokens are Apache-2.0. The following assets retain their own licenses. Copyright and permission notices are distributed in `licenses/`, including in each generated package.

- IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic: SIL Open Font License 1.1, IBM Corp. Exact unmodified native files and release hashes are in `fonts/families.json`; the license is `licenses/OFL-IBM-Plex.txt`.
- Noto Sans SC web fonts: SIL Open Font License 1.1, The Noto Project Authors. The locked Fontsource package carries the original license, copied to `licenses/OFL-Noto-Sans-SC.txt`.
- Interface icons: originals from the sets listed below. SVGs were normalized to monochrome paths and polygons; `icons/icons.json` records each icon's original name. Full upstream notices and license identities are recorded in `icons/upstream-licenses.json` and `licenses/`.
- DTCG 2025.10 format and resolver JSON schemas: Design Tokens Community Group contributors, W3C 3-clause BSD License (`licenses/W3C-BSD.txt`). The schemas are under `vendor/dtcg/2025.10/`. DTCG is a community report, not a W3C Recommendation.

Dependencies installed to run the generator retain the licenses in their locked packages.
